product_overview: A cloud security and governance platform that helps users sign in, create accounts, and complete onboarding to set up an organization and project. The product then supports security scanning, vulnerability visibility, and policy governance workflows for connected code and infrastructure.
core_goals: Sign in to access the security platform
Set up an organization during onboarding
Set up a project and connect a repository
Evaluate infrastructure and runtime policies against compliance baselines
Inspect audit trails and policy evaluation records

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows existing users to sign in with email and password to access the platform dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the platform dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email address incorrectly -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See validation feedback

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allows new users to create an account using their full name, company email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter full name -> Enter company email -> Enter password -> Submit the registration form -> See account creation confirmation or proceed to the next onboarding step

features.name: Organization Onboarding
features.description: Guides authenticated users through initial organization setup as part of onboarding.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding/organization -> Enter organization details -> Continue with onboarding -> See the next onboarding step

features.name: Project Onboarding
features.description: Guides authenticated users through project creation, repository provider selection, and initial scanner configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding/project -> Enter project name -> Select a repository provider -> Choose scanner modules -> Continue with onboarding -> See the platform dashboard

features.name: Security Scans and Findings Dashboard
features.description: Provides a unified view of detected security issues and scan results categorized by severity with remediation guidance.
user_flows: Navigate to /platform -> View open security findings -> Review issues by severity -> Inspect remediation suggestions

features.name: Policy Verification and Audit Trails
features.description: Supports policy evaluation against compliance baselines and review of audit evidence and execution history.
user_flows: Navigate to /platform -> Review policy evaluation results -> Compare outcomes against compliance baselines -> Inspect audit trail entries
